task: Add support for markitdown-mcp to codemie-mcp-connect-service

component_scope.label: S
component_scope.affected: MCP method routing (methods.py), URI validation utility (new module), Dockerfile runtime stage

technical_risk.label: S
technical_risk.risk_factors: URI validation for security (scheme restriction), integration with existing MCP method routing
technical_risk.mitigation: Comprehensive test coverage (22 tests across 3 test files), scheme allowlist (http, https, file, data), error handling with structured responses

key_reasoning.reason: Two components touched: MCP method routing logic added URI validation hook for convert_to_markdown tool, and Dockerfile runtime stage added pip install. Service layer pattern with infrastructure change.
Requirements were completely clear - add markitdown-mcp following existing MCP server pattern. Implementation matched spec exactly with no clarifications needed.

Security-sensitive URI validation implemented with scheme allowlist. Well-mitigated through 22 comprehensive tests (8 integration, 11 unit, 3 integration unit tests), covering all edge cases (empty URI, invalid schemes, scheme-only URIs, case-insensitivity).

7 files total: 3 modified (Dockerfile 1 line, README.md ~60 lines, methods.py ~15 lines), 4 new files (uri_validation.py ~40 lines, 3 test files ~300 lines total). Actual implementation was larger than predicted due to comprehensive test coverage and security validation requirements discovered during code review.
One new PyPI package added (markitdown-mcp via pip install). Follows established pattern for Python-based MCP servers in this codebase.
Service layer (MCP method routing + URI validation utility) and Infrastructure layer (Dockerfile runtime stage). No API contract changes, no database, no cross-system integration.
